title: Asian Markets Rise as US Inflation Eases and Crude Oil Drops
summary: Nifty 50 faces immediate opening-range resistance near 24,400 while GIFT Nifty points to a steady opening sentiment for Indian equities.
leadQuote: Asian stocks advanced after softer US inflation data bolstered Federal Reserve rate-cut expectations, while Brent crude fell back towards $82 per barrel.
